column4: Splash/menu composer: writes a glyph-index grid (e.g. 23x27 cells) into font-select SRAM (3-byte OSD word writer bank6:0x65d1 via port 0x92; row cmd bank6:0x6530), computes font_base, calls osd_set_font_bases (bank6:0x504d), sets window words + OSD scale 0x3A0A. docs/boot-logo.md.
Font-download orient/rotation (0x3A0B), writes 0x3A18, enables OSD via 0x3A02[0] (osd_enable_set bank6:0x5e35). Paired with osd_compose_glyph_grid_map. docs/boot-logo.md.

POWER-ON SPLASH builder (entry; 0x8f33 is its font-dl tail). Composes glyph grid (b0f4, R3=0x10,R5=0x18,R7=0x12), passes far ptr FF:38:2F (flash 0x1382F) + DBB7=SFR 0xFFFF (PBANK) to 0x4272. Reached only via bank0 FUN_CODE_d986 (thunk 0x0FAB) with timed delays. docs/boot-logo.md.
VCP MENU builder (entry; 0x4bd0 is its font-dl tail). Reads contrast/brightness e010/e034/e03e, 23x27 grid. Not the splash.
Font-dl tail of osd_builder_menu_vcp (caller of thunk 0x106b -> bank6:0x4272); far ptr FF:38:2F, descriptor 0x3837. Menu, not splash.
Font-dl tail of osd_builder_splash (caller of thunk 0x106b); far ptr FF:38:2F -> flash 0x1382F, bank=SFR 0xFFFF. THE SPLASH path.
Writes E1E8:E1E9 = font_base = DBB2(cell_w)*DBB3(rows)+(DBB3+1). E1E8:E1E9 is OSD-SRAM font_base, NOT a flash address. docs/boot-logo.md.

Glyph-set descriptor table. Preceded by 8-byte signature header at 0x382F (0f 12 34 56 78 9a bc de) read first by 0x4272. Descriptor 0x3837 = 00 08 00 00 00 00 00 00 c0 ff 00 09 11 98 f1 60 (len + far-ptr/len fields). Far ptr seg=0xFF=current bank; bank byte = SFR 0xFFFF at runtime. docs/boot-logo.md.
